items.title: Portnoy Law Firm Announces Class Action on Behalf of Innventure, Inc. Investors
items.summary: The Portnoy Law Firm has announced a class action lawsuit on behalf of Innventure, Inc. investors who purchased securities between November 17, 2025 and August 13, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Innventure and its officers misled investors about a purported 300MW data center deal with DarkNX. After a May 28, 2026 report questioned the deal's legitimacy, and following Innventure's August 13, 2026 disclosure that the DarkNX project was removed from internal bookings, the stock price fell 55% to $1.62 per share.

items.title: INV SHAREHOLDER ALERT: Securities Fraud Lawsuit Filed on Behalf of Innventure, Inc. Investors - Contact Kirby McInerney LLP by October 27, 2026
items.summary: Kirby McInerney LLP has filed a securities fraud class action lawsuit against Innventure, Inc. on behalf of investors who purchased securities between November 17, 2025 and August 13, 2026. The lawsuit alleges that Innventure made materially false statements regarding a transformative deal with DarkNX for an AI data center in Ontario, Canada, and overstated revenue and cash flow targets for its subsidiary Accelsius Holdings LLC. Following a May 28, 2026 Morpheus Research report questioning the deal's existence, and Innventure's August 13, 2026 disclosure that the deployment site was no longer available, the stock price fell 55% to $1.62 per share. The deadline to request lead plaintiff appointment is October 27, 2026.

items.title: INVESTOR ALERT: Pomerantz Law Firm Reminds Investors with Losses on their Investment in Innventure, Inc. of Class Action Lawsuit and Upcoming Deadlines – INV
items.summary: Pomerantz Law Firm has filed a class action lawsuit against Innventure, Inc., alleging securities fraud related to a fabricated DarkNX AI data center project in Ontario, Canada. A May 2026 Morpheus Research report claimed the project was non-existent with false revenue projections. Following the report and subsequent Q2 2026 earnings disclosure showing massive losses and suspended guidance, Innventure's stock plummeted 55.1% on August 14, 2026. Investors have until October 27, 2026, to request Lead Plaintiff status.

items.summary: Innventure, Inc. reported disappointing Q2 2026 results on August 13, 2026, missing earnings and revenue consensus estimates significantly and suspending its 2026 guidance for its Accelsius division. The company cited challenges in the AI infrastructure market including power availability and GPU access constraints for smaller companies. The stock fell 55.1% to $1.62 per share on August 14, 2026, prompting a securities fraud investigation.

items.title: Innventure, Inc. (INV) Shareholders Who Lost Money – Contact Law Offices of Howard G. Smith About Securities Fraud Investigation
items.summary: Law Offices of Howard G. Smith is investigating Innventure, Inc. for possible federal securities law violations. On August 13, 2026, Innventure reported disappointing Q2 2026 results with a loss per share of $0.32 (missing consensus by $0.15) and revenue of $953,000 (missing by $1.02 million). The company suspended its 2026 revenue and cash flow targets for Accelsius, citing challenges in the AI infrastructure market including power availability and GPU access constraints for smaller companies. The stock fell 55.1% to $1.62 per share on August 14, 2026.
